description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single hybrid ranged attacks (0.60 or 1.50 each), grants [ATK and DEF +50% (25s)] or [DEF and MAG +50% (25s)] to the user, grants [Attach Dark 3 with Stacking], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Scheming Statesman Mode] to the user

description.name: Dark Domination
description.text: Six single ranged hybrid attacks (0.90 or 3.05 each), damages the user for 25%/15%/5% max HP scaling with activations, grants [Damage Cap +10000 1] to the user

description.name: Shadow Tactics
description.text: One single ranged hybrid attack (6.00 or 16.40) capped at 99999, sets the user's HP to 1 if the user has [Scheming Statesman Mode], grants [Dark Ability +30% Boost 2] to the user if the user has [Scheming Statesman Mode]

description.name: Attach Dark 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Dark Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Dark 3

description.name: Scheming Statesman Mode
description.text: Restores HP for 100% of the user's maximum HP when HP fall below 20%, grants [Last Stand] and casts Evil Sephira when HP fall below 20%

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands
